headword: {不在連絡票|ふざいれんらくひょう}
reading: ふざいれんらくひょう
gloss: missed delivery notice; absence notification slip

definitions.gloss: missed delivery notice; absence notification slip
definitions.explanation: A slip left by a delivery driver when the recipient is not home. It contains information for scheduling a redelivery, including a tracking number and contact details.

examples.japanese: {不在連絡票|ふざいれんらくひょう}がポストに{入|はい}っていた。
examples.english: A missed delivery notice was in the mailbox.

examples.japanese: {不在連絡票|ふざいれんらくひょう}に{書|か}いてある{番号|ばんごう}に{電話|でんわ}して{再配達|さいはいたつ}を{依頼|いらい}した。
examples.english: I called the number on the missed delivery notice and requested redelivery.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{不在連絡票|ふざいれんらくひょう}のQRコードから{再配達|さいはいたつ}の{手続|てつづ}きができるようになった。
examples.english: Recently, you can arrange redelivery through the QR code on the missed delivery notice.

notes:
Composed of {不在|ふざい} (absence), {連絡|れんらく} (contact, notification), and {票|ひょう} (slip, form). A very practical term for daily life in Japan, where package delivery is extremely common.

Most delivery companies in Japan ({宅配便|たくはいびん}) leave this slip and allow redelivery scheduling by phone, internet, or app.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不在連絡票|ふざいれんらくひょう}で{再配達|さいはいたつ}を{依頼|いらい}する (to request redelivery using the notice)
- {不在連絡票|ふざいれんらくひょう}が{届|とど}く (to receive a missed delivery notice)
- {不在連絡票|ふざいれんらくひょう}の{番号|ばんごう} (number on the delivery notice)
